methodology: Read original local catalog2025-26.pdf directly using PyMuPDF text extraction and original-page coordinate crops. Visually rendered and reviewed pages174,183,255,266. Independently enumerated named pools and interpreted source headings, OR markers and footnotes before comparing with public/data/catalogs.json. No importer definitions, old coverage/review reports or pre-existing extracted curriculum lists read. Runtime catalog used only for claim/path/group identifiers and comparison. Printed and PDF page numbers coincide in these regions. Contains mandatory assertions verify cited rows rather than whole curricula. Exact group assertions enumerate the complete named list but do not claim full program verification.
